resources.title: A Beginner's Guide To Old School RuneScape (OSRS Starter Guide)
resources.creator: Theoatrix OSRS
resources.noteEs: Guía de arranque completa para cuentas nuevas: qué hacer al salir de Tutorial Island, primeras prioridades y cómo armar un plan de progresión. Ideal si nunca tocaste OSRS.
resources.noteEn: A complete starter guide for fresh accounts: what to do after Tutorial Island, early priorities, and how to build a progression plan. Perfect if you've never played OSRS.

resources.title: A beginners guide to Runescape (2024)
resources.creator: Protoxx
resources.noteEs: Recorrido para principiantes que cubre lo esencial del early game: dinero, quests útiles y achievement diaries. Pensado para que un jugador nuevo no pierda horas.
resources.noteEn: A beginner walkthrough covering the early-game essentials: money, useful quests, and achievement diaries. Built so a new player doesn't waste hours.

resources.title: COMPLETE beginner's guide to Old School Runescape
resources.creator: WildMudkip
resources.noteEs: Guía larga y detallada que acompaña una cuenta nueva paso a paso por el early y mid game. Útil cuando quieres una referencia exhaustiva en un solo video.
resources.noteEn: A long, detailed guide that walks a fresh account step by step through the early and mid game. Useful when you want one exhaustive reference in a single video.

resources.title: New Runescape Players Are Being Misguided (#3)
resources.creator: J1mmy
resources.noteEs: Una mirada crítica a los malos consejos que reciben los jugadores nuevos, con un enfoque más relajado sobre cómo disfrutar el juego sin obsesionarse con la eficiencia.
resources.noteEn: A critical look at the bad advice new players get, with a more laid-back take on enjoying the game without obsessing over efficiency.

resources.title: 101 Tips & Tricks for OSRS (2026 Edition)
resources.creator: Theoatrix OSRS
resources.noteEs: 101 tips rápidos que cubren atajos, quality of life y trucos que ahorran tiempo en todo el juego. Sirve tanto para principiantes como para volver tras una pausa.
resources.noteEn: 101 quick tips covering shortcuts, quality-of-life features, and time-saving tricks across the whole game. Great for beginners and for players returning after a break.
